Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

DIRECTIONS OF OPERATION OF TOGGLE 

SWITCHES ON AIRCRAFT 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 



1. Scope — Specifies tiie directions of operation o1 toggle switches installed on the flight deck of an 
aircraft. 

2. Directions of Operation 

2.1 Switches shall be mounted such that the direction of operation is as given below: 



o 
Q 



o. 
W 

T3 

C 
(0 

£ 
o 



Mounting Position of the Switch 


,1 
Directions of Operation 


ON 


OFF 


On vertical panel 

On horizontal panel 
( switch upright) 

On horizontal panel 
( switch inverted ) 


Upward 
Forward 

Backward 


Downward 
Backward 

Forward 



2.2 The directions of operation are specified relative to the working position of the operator. 
2-3 Typical examples showing the directions of operation are given below: 






t)N -forward 



Note — The operator is shown sitting in his normal working position, which may be independent of aircraft axis.
